column2: Paano mag-number ng rows per partition?
column4: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at) FROM orders;

column2: Paano mag-rank ng users ayon sa points?
column4: SELECT name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY points DESC) FROM users;
SELECT name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY points DESC) FROM users;

column2: Paano mag-hiwa ng users sa 4 na quartiles?
column4: SELECT name, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY points DESC) FROM users;
